payload.summary: The council's consultation page on Get Talking Norwich, covering two policies at once: a new homelessness strategy and the Home Options rules for allocating council homes. It says the consultation was open “from Monday 10 November 2025 to Sunday 7 December 2025”, and offers a draft policy, a briefing note and an equality impact assessment to read before answering the survey. Since it closed the council has added a “you said, we did” update naming what it changed in the allocations proposal because of what people said. The page also gives two round numbers for housing pressure in Norwich — around 4,000 people waiting for social housing and over 1,200 enquiries a month — without saying when either was counted.

ai.reviewed_by: two independent AI review passes, reconciled against the source documents, 7 September 2026
